Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of transportation to begin the environmental planning process and prepare the final design for the state route number 9 Snohomish river bridge replacement project.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a state route number 9 Snohomish river bridgeenvironmental planning process and design; adding a new section tochapter 47.01 RCW; creating a new section; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The intent of this act is to identify andfund a project of significance to the Snohomish region.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of transportation shall begin the environmentalplanning process as required under the state environmental policy act,chapter 43.21C RCW, or the national environmental policy act ifapplicable, for the state route number 9 Snohomish river bridgereplacement project. In conjunction with the environmental planningprocess, the department shall prepare a final design for the project.

The sum of five million five hundred sixtythousand dollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is p. 1 SB 6072appropriated for the biennium ending June 30, 2011, from the motorvehicle account to the department of transportation for the purposes ofsection 2 of this act.
